servinfo.title: Front Brake Caliper Disassembly and Reassembly

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Front Brake Caliper Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Clean surfaces around caliper with brake cleaner before disassembly.
Remove brake piston by blowing air into the hole for front brake flexible hose joint bolt.

attention2.ptxt: If you place your fingers in front of the piston when you push it out with compressed air, you may hurt your fingers.
Do not place your fingers in front of the piston when removing it using compressed air.

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions while servicing front brake caliper and brake piston may damage piston and/or brake caliper.

item.ptxt: Place a cloth (1) in front of the piston to prevent it from jumping out.
Do not scratch sealing surface (2) with air blow gun.
Use a moderate air pressure to push the piston out of the cylinder slowly.

s1.ptxt: Remove piston boot (1) and bleeder plug (2) from brake caliper (3).
Remove piston seal (1) from cylinder of front brake caliper (3) using flat-bladed screwdriver (2) or the like.

attention4.ptxt: If the inside surface of the cylinder (bore wall) and outside surface of piston are damaged, brake fluid leakage may result.
Be extremely careful not to damage the inside surface of the cylinder and outside surface of piston when removing the piston seal.

topic.title: Slide pin
topic.ptxt: Remove slide pins (1) and pin boots (2) from front brake caliper carrier (3).

attention1.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when assembling the brake caliper can result in brake system failure, which could lead to an accident.

item.ptxt: Clean each part before installation using the same brake fluid as that in the master cylinder reservoir.
Never use any other brake fluid or volatile solvent.
Before installing the piston seal and piston boot to the piston, apply rubber grease included in the piston seal set or brake fluid to them.
Fit a new piston seal securely into the groove of the cylinder checking that it is not twisted.

s1.ptxt: Perform the following steps before installing brake piston to front brake caliper.

s2.ptxt: Check entire periphery of brake piston and inside surface of cylinder for rust, corrosion and any other damage. If check result is not OK, replace brake piston and/or front brake caliper.
After applying rubber grease included in piston seal set of supply parts or specified brake fluid to new piston seal (1), fit the seal into groove in cylinder taking care not to twist the seal.

spec.title: Brake fluid specification
spec.ptxt: Refer to reservoir cap of brake master cylinder or Owner’s Manual.

s2.ptxt: Apply rubber grease included in piston seal set of supply parts or specified brake fluid to new piston boot (1). And then install it onto brake piston as shown.

s1.ptxt: Fit piston boot (1) with piston into boot groove in cylinder by hand as shown below.
Insert brake piston (1) into cylinder by hand and fit piston boot (2) in boot groove on brake piston.

attention3.ptxt: Check that boot is securely fitted in boot grooves in piston and cylinder.

s1.ptxt: To check that piston boot (2) is fitted in its groove in cylinder properly, pull piston (1) a little outward without moving it fully out.
Insert piston into cylinder by hand.
Install bleeder plug to front brake caliper and tighten it to specified torque.
Check the following points before installing slide pins to front brake caliper carrier.

s2.ptxt: Check slide pins for rust, corrosion and other damage. Replace slide pin if defective.
Install new pin boot(s) (1) to front brake caliper carrier (2) with their ends directed as shown below.
Apply rubber grease included in pin boot set of supply parts to slide pin (1).

s1.ptxt: Install slide pin without bushing (1) into upper side and slide pin with bushing (2) into lower side of front brake caliper carrier (3) as shown.
